correctness.rationale: The upper bound 16 has a direct injective four-coordinate projection proof. Risk is confined to ordinary implementation error; two distinct clique-enumeration routines and explicit invariants reduce that risk.

value.rationale: The case \(b=3\) is the first read-window width beyond the extensively studied symbol-pair setting, and equality in the Singleton bound is the canonical extremal regime. The result supplies a complete finite equality-case landscape rather than another construction: \(76\) maxima, five natural symmetry types, and a sharp affine/nonlinear split with all \(32\) nonlinear extrema in one orbit. This is a natural benchmark for MDS \(b\)-symbol constructions and structural questions, not an arbitrary coordinate slice.
